newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Part-Tutsi Zaire opposition figure detained.
newsitem.headline: Part-Tutsi Zaire opposition figure detained.

text.p: A part-Tutsi member of Zaire's main opposition party and former deputy minister has been detained, his party said on Saturday.

The Union for Democracy and Social Progress said Willy Mishiki, a former deputy agriculture minister whose mother is a Tutsi, had been detained by internal security police since Monday. No reason had been given for his arrest.
Anti-Tutsi feeling has been growing in the chaotic Central African state since a coalition of Tutsi and other rebels backed by Rwanda's Tutsi-dominated army took over a swathe of eastern Zaire.
Tutsis who were among Zaire's most succesful entrepeneurs have been forced to seek refuge abroad.
Part-Tutsi Prime Minister Kengo wa Dondo has been accused by student demonstrators of not doing enough to fight the war.
